blocks.prompt: 12. If the numbers 1, 4 and 3 are subtracted from three consecutive terms of an A.P., the resulting numbers are in G.P. Find the original numbers if their sum is 21.
blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein A.P. aur G.P. dono hain: A.P. ke teen terms mein se kuch minus karne par G.P. ban jati hai.
Diya kya hai? A.P. ke teen terms ka sum 21, aur 1, 4, 3 minus karne par G.P.
Find kya karna hai? Asal teen numbers.
Plan: terms \(a - d, a, a + d\) maanenge; sum se \(a\), phir G.P. ki sharait se \(d\) ki quadratic equation.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: A.P. ke teen terms, sum 21; 1, 4, 3 minus karne par G.P.
Humein find karna hai: A.P. ke terms.
Tareeqa: A.P. ke teen terms ke liye \(a - d, a, a + d\) lena behtareen chunaao hai, kyunke jama karte waqt \(d\) cancel ho jata hai aur ek hi qadam mein \(a\) mil jata hai.

Sum se \(a\)
\[(a - d) + a + (a + d) = 21\]
\[3a = 21 \Rightarrow a = 7\]
Kyun: \(-d\) aur \(+d\) aapas mein khatam ho gaye, sirf \(3a\) bacha. Beech wala term hamesha teenon ka average hota hai: \(21 \div 3 = 7\).

1, 4, 3 minus karein
\[7 - d - 1 = 6 - d\]
\[7 - 4 = 3\]
\[7 + d - 3 = 4 + d\]
Kyun: Pehle number se 1, doosre se 4 aur teesre se 3 minus kiya, usi tarteeb mein jo sawal mein hai.
Dhyan dein: Tarteeb badalna (jaise pehle se 3 minus karna) poora jawab ghalat kar deta hai.

G.P. ki sharait lagayein
\[3^2 = (6 - d)(4 + d)\]
\[9 = 24 + 2d - d^2\]
\[d^2 - 2d - 15 = 0\]
Kyun: Teen terms G.P. mein hon to beech wale ka square = pehla \(\times\) teesra. Right side khola: \(6 \cdot 4 = 24\), \(6d - 4d = 2d\), \(-d \cdot d = -d^2\). Phir sab ko ek taraf la kar \(d^2\) ko positive rakha.

\(d\) nikalein
\[(d - 5)(d + 3) = 0\]
\[d = 5 \text{ or } d = -3\]
Kyun: Aise do numbers chahiye jin ka product \(-15\) aur sum \(-2\) ho: \(-5\) aur \(3\). Is liye factors \((d - 5)(d + 3)\).

Numbers likhein
\[d = 5:\ 2, 7, 12\]
\[d = -3:\ 10, 7, 4\]
Kyun: \(a = 7\) aur har \(d\) ko \(a - d, a, a + d\) mein rakha. Dono values jaaiz hain, is liye do jawab hain (doosra pehle ka ulta hai).

Tasdeeq
\[2, 7, 12 \to 1, 3, 9\ (r = 3)\]
\[10, 7, 4 \to 9, 3, 1\ (r = \tfrac{1}{3})\]
Kyun: Dono sets ka sum 21 hai. 1, 4, 3 minus karne par \(1, 3, 9\) aur \(9, 3, 1\) bante hain, jo dono G.P. hain. Sab sharait poori.
